description: This header file declares an abstract interface class 'InterfaceFlagsReader' within the 'beerocks::net' namespace. The class provides a pure virtual function to read network interface flags by interface name and output a bitmask of flags. It is intended to be implemented by derived classes for reading network interface flags in different environments.

classes.name: InterfaceFlagsReader
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface for reading network interface flags.

methods.name: read_flags
methods.description: Pure virtual method to read the interface flags of a specified network interface.
parameters: const std::string &iface_name - name of the network interface
uint16_t &iface_flags - output parameter for interface flags (bitmask)
methods.return: bool - true if reading was successful, false otherwise
